messages:
Sofia Patel: quick sync 1: we have two pilots asking for more prescriptive Optimize kit defaults. want to align on scope + launch gates. TL;DR: per-model quant guidance, adaptive batching presets, eval-driven alerts + rollback.
Ethan Kim: ok. can we get concrete performance targets from pilots? that'll determine how aggressive quant/batching we can recommend.
Sofia Patel: Pilot A (RetailX): latency critical for short queries -> target p99 <= 120ms @ 50 qps, contexts <= 256. Pilot B (DocsAI): cost-first, longer contexts (~2048), willing p99 up to 400ms at 8 qps but need >=30% token-cost savings.
Priya Rao: two lanes then. My suggestion: ship "fast" and "thrifty" presets in the SDK. fast = prioritize cache reuse + conservative quant (fp16/2x-activation cache), thrifty = prefer 4-bit quant + larger batch windows. Defaults should be toggles in SDK call: optimize_preset: fast|thrifty.
Ravi G.: technical note: some LLMs lose safety/accuracy at aggressive quant. we must include automatic per-model microbenchmarks that run a tiny eval set and mark a profile safe/experimental. runtime should log profile score: "perf_delta" and "qa_delta" (numbers in string).
Sofia Patel: agreed. requirement: profile-driven recommendations only, customers can opt-in to experimental profiles. docs must clearly state risk.
Ethan Kim: on eval-alerts: propose three triggers: metric drop (relative), hallucination rate spike, and latency degradation. When fired: 1) alert to console/email/slack, 2) optionally auto-roll back to previous model or profile. Need a customer-controlled policy (off/alert/alert+rollback).
Lena (design): will mock a simple alert inbox + example failing prompt set view. customers need an easy way to inspect the triggers and mute noisy alerts.
Priya Rao: rollout plan: internal staging -> pilot cohort -> general availability. Launch gates: - staging run reproduces rollback path, - preset telemetry surfaced in console, - docs + quickstart one-pager, - SDK flag for experiments + sample code snippet.
Sofia Patel: acceptance criteria draft: Alerts: configurable trigger thresholds, delivery channels wired, and rollback function validated in staging. Fast lane: sample harness shows <=120ms p99 for 85% of short-chat samples. Thrifty lane: >=30% token-cost reduction vs baseline for 75% of long-context samples with <=7% quality loss by eval metric.
Ravi G.: add a safety gate: any profile that increases hallucination rate by >3% on the small eval must be marked as 'do not recommend'.
Ethan Kim: infra tasks: build lightweight microbenchmark runner (per-model, per-profile) that outputs csv strings we can ingest. Also extend telemetry to tag requests with preset name. I'll own infra proto. ETA EOD Friday.
Sofia Patel: docs tasks: produce two one-pagers (fast, thrifty), checklist for pilot acceptance, sample SDK snippets. I'll own docs + PR.
Lena (design): i'll drop wireframes for alert inbox and failing prompt set view by tomorrow.
Priya Rao: I'll draft SDK toggles + CLI commands for running microbenchmarks. also add examples for opt-in to experimental quant.
ops-bot: synthetic-run scheduled: optkit-pilot-smoke-3024 at 2024-05-02T21:00:00Z. will post results in #product.
Sofia Patel: ok team, sync tomorrow 9:30am. Goal: have staging profile runner and initial docs + design mocks for pilot kickoff next week. short and focused. :rocket:
